actionLog: Draw tool now supports multi-step drawings — Ctrl/Cmd+drag draws one stroke, release and drag again to add another stroke to the same drawing, Escape finishes and opens the comment box. Turning draw mode on also shows a 4-color palette (purple default, plus blue/red/yellow) now.
